content.short: The LATAM Cardano Community is a regional hub for education, adoption, and governance in Latin America.
content.description: The LATAM Cardano Community is a decentralized alliance dedicated to fostering blockchain education and adoption across Latin America. As a vital regional hub, the community organizes regular town halls and workshops in Spanish and Portuguese to discuss ecosystem updates and Project Catalyst proposals. The group plays a crucial role in ensuring regional representation in Cardano governance, specifically through initiatives related to CIP-1694. By supporting local developers and entrepreneurs, the LATAM Cardano Community empowers individuals to build and thrive within the decentralized economy.
